title: Not worth the torture
body: I mean, it’s AI. It’s got a lot of issues and kind of rooted in evil because of all the things that AI comes with in that regard. So use discernment. With that said, sure, you get sucked in and be entertained for a little bit, like a soap opera, but where it gets evil and absolutely ridiculous is once you download the app (the only way to see the plot through), your options are to pay, which this is absolutely not worth paying for - especially what they’re asking, so you opt for the free ad option, but literally every 10 seconds you’re forced to watch another ad, but its the kind of ads that you can’t get out of. It’s absolutely infuriating. When you finally get out of it, you get watch 20 seconds of watch time and have to do it again and again. This is the worst and most unethical kind way to roll and I won’t have any part of it. I hope you won’t support it either. There’s such better, kinder ways to do this. The fact that they chose this model shows me who I’m dealing with and the evil just continues. So no thank you. Please don’t support.
